description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, providing CRUD operations for Note objects stored in a local SQLite database in an Android application.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A class that manages CRUD operations for notes, interfacing with an SQLite database.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last updated time descending.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches notes by a query string in the title or content.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its unique ID.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: mapCursorToNotes
methods.description: Converts a Cursor object into a list of Note instances.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a single Cursor row to a Note object.
